description:
Extract the station-elevation geometry of the most upstream cross-section from the Muncie HEC-RAS model HDF file. Compute geometric hydraulic properties (Flow Area, Wetted Perimeter, Top Width, Hydraulic Radius) at 25 evenly-spaced water surface elevations ranging from the thalweg (minimum bed elevation) to the maximum bank elevation.

Save the results to a CSV file at '/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/stage_area_curve.csv' with columns: 'Stage', 'FlowArea', 'WettedPerimeter', 'TopWidth', 'HydraulicRadius'.

Also save a summary text file to '/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/cross_section_info.txt' containing the River Station identifier and number of points.

Finally, generate a 2x2 multi-panel plot of these properties vs. Stage and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/stage_area_plot.png'.

The input HDF file is located at '/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_projects/Muncie/Muncie.p04.hdf'. You should use Python (h5py, numpy, pandas, matplotlib) to perform this analysis.
